function_specs.name: LinklistSuspend
function_specs.meaning: Frozen semaphore_ic: invalid flag returns -10 unchanged; valid flag suspends through imported API and transfers the sched node into the selected Semaphore FIFO/priority position, restoring os_inv. Derived semaphore_prio_ic fixes flag1 and return0.

function_specs.name: SuspendKTask
function_specs.meaning: Imported suspend_by_id_ic returns identified task and existing suspension effect with complete os_inv; actual registered ID is read then restored before call.

function_specs.meaning: Existing polymorphic dispatch_case inserts the owned node before the actual anchor; explicitly instantiated at Z without changing contract.

function_specs.name: DoubleLinkListInsertNodeAfter
